exercise_name: Just Give Me A Reason · Listening & Vocabulary
description: 《Just Give Me a Reason》描寫一對戀人在感情出現裂痕後，努力尋找理解與重新相愛的可能。女方察覺彼此逐漸疏遠，開始懷疑對方是否已經失去愛意；男方卻認為感情依然存在，只是雙方缺乏溝通，令誤解與不安不斷累積。兩人雖然對問題有不同的看法，卻仍然珍惜曾經擁有的幸福，希望找到修補關係的方法。歌曲以「彎曲而未破碎」象徵受傷卻仍有希望的愛情。最終，《Just Give Me a Reason》傳達的是愛情中的信任、溝通與重新開始的勇氣：即使感情經歷挫折，只要雙方願意坦誠面對問題、理解彼此的感受，仍有機會修復傷痕，重新找回曾經的親密與幸福。

vocabulary.meaning: 從一開始就；強調事情開始的那一刻
vocabulary.usage: 用在故事、計畫或經驗的開頭，通常放在句首或句尾。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「right from the start」？
options: Right from the start, our new robot called the teacher “Grandma.”
We arrived right from the start the airport at noon.
The film was right from the start for three hours.
Please right from the start this computer before class.
optionExplanations: 正確：表示機器人一開始就叫老師「奶奶」，既自然又好笑。
錯誤：這個片語不能代替表示地點的 at；應說 arrived at the airport。
錯誤：不能用它表示一段時間的長度；應說 lasted three hours。
錯誤：這不是「啟動」的動詞；應說 start this computer。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示機器人一開始就叫老師「奶奶」，既自然又好笑。

vocabulary.meaning: 願意的；自願做某件事的
vocabulary.usage: 常用 be willing to + 原形動詞，表示願意做某事。
options: I am willing helping at the museum this weekend.
Our coach is willing to wear a pink cape if we win the final.
The train is willing at platform five.
She willing to teach me how to play chess.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：willing 後要接 to help，不能直接接 helping。
正確：be willing to wear 表示教練願意穿粉紅披風慶祝。
錯誤：willing 描述意願，不表示火車停靠的位置。
錯誤：willing 是形容詞，前面需要 is；應說 She is willing to teach me。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：be willing to wear 表示教練願意穿粉紅披風慶祝。

vocabulary.usage: 指睡著時不自覺說話；可依主詞改變 your / his / her。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「talk in your sleep」？
options: My uncle talks in his sleep every morning at breakfast.
I talked in my sleep because I sent an email at work.
My sister talks in her sleep and sometimes gives speeches about space.
The actors talked in their sleep on stage while they were fully awake.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：早餐時清醒地說話不叫說夢話。
錯誤：寄工作郵件是清醒行為，不能用來解釋說夢話。
正確：表示妹妹睡著時會說夢話，甚至談太空。
錯誤：既然演員完全清醒，就不是真正在說夢話。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示妹妹睡著時會說夢話，甚至談太空。

vocabulary.usage: 常用 have had enough of + 名詞／動名詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「have had enough」？
options: We have had enough of the broken lift, so we are taking the stairs.
I have had enough to the long meeting.
The photographer has had enough with waiting in the rain.
She has had enough the loud music from next door.
optionExplanations: 正確：表示大家受夠壞掉的電梯，決定走樓梯。
錯誤：這裡要用 of the long meeting，不是 to。
錯誤：標準搭配是 had enough of waiting，而非 with waiting。
錯誤：缺少介系詞 of；應說 enough of the loud music。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示大家受夠壞掉的電梯，決定走樓梯。

vocabulary.usage: 可描述金屬、形狀或物體；也可用於比喻，與 broken 不同。
options: The street was bent because the shops were closed.
The cyclist checked his wheel because it looked bent after the race.
My phone is bent because its battery is almost empty.
The singer felt bent when the crowd cheered loudly.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：商店關門不會讓街道變彎；這裡因果不合理。
正確：賽後車輪看起來彎了，bent 使用自然。
錯誤：電量低不代表手機形狀彎曲。
錯誤：歡呼讓人高興或興奮，不是形容身體／物品彎曲。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：賽後車輪看起來彎了，bent 使用自然。

vocabulary.usage: 可用於皮膚上的疤痕，也能比喻痛苦經驗留下的影響。
options: The weather report said there would be three scars tomorrow.
I bought a scar to travel from Paris to Rome.
The old cut left a small scar on his arm.
The musician turned up the scar so everyone could hear the song.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：天氣預報不會用 scar 表示降雨或暴風雨。
錯誤：scar 不是車票或交通工具；應說 ticket。
正確：傷口痊癒後在手臂留下小疤痕。
錯誤：scar 不是音量；應說 turned up the volume。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：傷口痊癒後在手臂留下小疤痕。

vocabulary.meaning: 只是你想像的；問題並非客觀存在（依語境）
vocabulary.usage: 常用於安慰或反駁猜測，但不應隨意否定他人真實的感受。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「all in your mind」？
options: You think the whole audience hates you, but that may be all in your mind.
The museum opens at nine; it is all in your mind on the website.
I left my wallet all in your mind on the train.
We put the science project all in your mind next to the window.
optionExplanations: 正確：表示觀眾討厭你的想法可能只是自己的猜測。
錯誤：網站上的開放時間是資訊，不是想像出來的。
錯誤：片語不是「留在某處」，也不能代替 on the train。
錯誤：它不表示物品的實際擺放位置。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示觀眾討厭你的想法可能只是自己的猜測。

vocabulary.meaning: （想像、情緒等）不受控制；自由奔馳
vocabulary.usage: 常用 imagination runs wild 或 fears run wild。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「run wild」？
options: The pilot ran wild the plane at six in the morning.
When the lights went out in the castle, the children's imaginations ran wild.
I ran wild my passport at the hotel desk.
The chef ran wild the soup for ten minutes.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：run wild 不能當作「駕駛飛機」的及物動詞。
正確：城堡突然停電，孩子們開始天馬行空地想像。
錯誤：這個片語不表示出示證件；應說 showed my passport。
錯誤：煮湯不能用 run wild；應說 cooked the soup。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：城堡突然停電，孩子們開始天馬行空地想像。

vocabulary.meaning: 積灰塵；因長期不用而閒置
vocabulary.usage: 常說 something is collecting dust，強調物品被放著不用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「collect dust」？
options: The swimmer collected dust by swimming faster than everyone else.
The airport collected dust because many planes arrived early.
I collect dust when I write secret notes to my friends.
My old guitar has been collecting dust since I started learning drums.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：游得快不等於積灰塵；這個片語不表示贏得比賽。
錯誤：航班提早抵達與物品閒置積塵沒有關係。
錯誤：寫紙條不是 collect dust 的意思；可說 write notes。
正確：舊吉他因為改學鼓而長期閒置、積灰塵。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：舊吉他因為改學鼓而長期閒置、積灰塵。

vocabulary.meaning: 坦白說出真相；承認原本隱瞞的事
vocabulary.usage: 通常是 come clean about + 事情，或 come clean with + 人。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪個句子正確使用「come clean」？
options: The engineer came clean the window before the inspection.
We came clean to the cinema at seven o’clock.
The mayor came clean of the city hall after lunch.
The class president finally came clean about losing the concert tickets.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：come clean 不是「擦乾淨」；應說 cleaned the window。
錯誤：come clean 不是「到達」；應說 arrived at the cinema。
錯誤：come clean 不表示從建築物走出來；應說 came out of。
正確：班長終於坦白弄丟演唱會門票。
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：班長終於坦白弄丟演唱會門票。
